Thanks again for taking the time this morning — great conversation and lots of alignment on product fit. Quick recap and the asks I mentioned so we can get you an apples-to-apples price comparison vs OpenAI/Anthropic and hosted open-model providers.

4) Any contractual preferences (commit levels, minimums, invoice vs card, procurement timelines).

As a heads up, we typically provide a 3-tier proposal: conservative (no commit), target (modest commit), and aggressive (volume commit + multi-month). We'll include a $/1M token target for each tier and show a line-by-line comparison vs OpenAI/Anthropic and common open-model hosts.

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the clear recap — this aligns with our notes. Quick answers to your questions below:

1) Volumes: We expect ~30M tokens/month in the first 3 months of a pilot. If things go well, plan for a linear ramp to ~100M tokens/month over 9–12 months (peak days could approach ~5M tokens/day).
2) Current blended price: right now we're using a mix of OpenAI and a third-party host; blended is roughly $1,100 / 1M tokens (including completions and system prompts).
3) Budget: Pilot budget is small — roughly $20k–$30k/month. For production we would be comfortable planning for $80k–$120k/month depending on unit economics. Our procurement team has said that anything north of $900/1M will be a stretch without clear cost savings elsewhere.
4) Contract preferences: would prefer a 6–12 month term with a minimum commit if the unit price is attractive; invoice is preferred (PO + net 30). Procurement needs ~3 weeks notice for legal review.

Goal: Ideally we want a target price in the $500–$700 / 1M tokens range once scaled — if Redwood can get close to that at 100M+ tokens, procurement will prioritize.

Happy to hop on a quick follow-up with procurement next week if that helps.

Thanks,

Vanessa / Rishi — draft pricing and benchmarking summary below. Attaching populated pricing_model.xlsx and a CSV comparison we use internally (redwood-vs-hosts-pricing.csv).

Summary (for Acme):
- Volumes: baseline 30M tokens/mo; ramp to 100M tokens/mo at scale.

Three-tier proposal (all $ per 1M tokens, blended prompt+completion):
- Conservative (no commit): $1,000 / 1M tokens — available immediately, no minimums.
- Target (small commit): $650 / 1M tokens — requires 3-month minimum commit equivalent to ~40M tokens/mo average across term or a 6-month ramp schedule.
- Aggressive (volume commit): $450 / 1M tokens — requires 12-month commit at 100M tokens/mo or equivalent annualized usage (preferred for customers comfortable with predictable volume).

Notes on benchmarking vs common hosts:
- OpenAI (chat-based models): current published vendor rates are higher in many cases; blended customer cost we see for similar workloads ~ $900–$1,300 / 1M depending on model and context windows.
- Anthropic: often similar or slightly higher depending on model choice and API footprint.
- Hosted open-model providers: pricing varies widely; some offer lower unit price but higher latency or lower SLAs.

Unit economics / rationale (brief):
- Infra cost per 1M tokens: depends on model family and quantization; with optimized batching and KV caching we estimate infra cost at scale ~ $150–$250 / 1M for the model mix Acme described.
- OpEx & margin: our target and aggressive tiers assume higher commit volume to amortize infra and margin, allowing $650 and $450 targets respectively while preserving business margin and support SLAs.
- Tradeoffs: very low unit prices (< $400/1M) typically require either non-production SLAs or substantial upfront commit.

Recommended next steps to land:
1) Share the 3-tier proposal with Acme and confirm whether procurement prefers commit-based discounting.
2) Run a 2–4 week pilot (PO + net30) at the Target tier with a 30–60 day eval window to validate latency and quality.
3) If pilot meets latency/quality, convert to an Aggressive commit and finalize a 12-month contract.

Attachments: pricing_model.xlsx (populated), redwood-vs-hosts-pricing.csv

Happy to review before you send, Vanessa.

— Marissa Cole

- Target (recommended for pilot): $650 / 1M tokens — requires a modest commit (3 months at ~40M tokens/month equivalent or a 6-month ramp). Pilot within budget at your stated $20k–$30k/month is feasible under this tier.

Why these numbers matter: at 100M tokens/month the Target tier saves ~ $45k+/month vs your current blended ~$1,100/1M start point; the Aggressive tier delivers even larger savings and predictable cost. Details and assumptions are in the attached pricing_model.xlsx.
